dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Program ORCGI41 is the inpatient accounting card input component (入院会計カード入力 I41).
evidence: fixed format, no IBM-specific COMP-3 usage

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical institution inpatient billing/accounting system (入院会計カード入力). Part of the JMA ORCA standard receipt software used by Japanese clinics and hospitals for medical fee calculation and billing.
purpose.summary: ORCGI41 is the inpatient accounting card input program (入院会計カード入力 I41) within the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It handles entry and calculation of inpatient hospitalization fees, special admission charges, meal charges, and related billing items, producing monthly accounting records for inpatient stays. The program manages complex Japanese medical fee rules including specific admission fee types, psychiatric emergency fees, rehabilitation fees, and various add-on charges.

notable_features: No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
No COMP-3 usage (unusual for billing system)
Extensive revision history in comments spanning 2002-2010
verdict.notes: File decoded with latin-1 but comments are actually Japanese EUC-JP encoded, causing mojibake in the transcription. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of ~456KB total. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. Fixed-format COBOL with lines occasionally exceeding column 72 (63 such lines) suggesting some free-form identifiers or long literals.
